name: Trail SPD pedal pair
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed average 485 g for the left/right PD-ME700 SPD pedal pair, from the explicit /pair weight row in the 2025–2026 specification handbook. The handbook notes a supplied 1.0 mm cleat spacer; the weight row does not enumerate cleats or loose accessories.
